Major Taylor Thirsty Thursday

Germantown, TN

No-drop

Major Taylor Thirsty Thursday is a road group ride in Germantown, TN. It meets every Thursday, 6:00 pm (late March–late September), starting at Trek Bicycle Germantown (parking lot north of the tennis courts). Expect about 20–28 miles, B/C/D groups.

About the Major Taylor Thirsty Thursday group ride

Thursday evening no-drop ride in Germantown, run under the Hightailers' Major Taylor banner. Twenty to twenty-eight miles in B, C and D groups. Seasonal, spring through September.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
